segments.name: Mobility Technologies
products: operating software platform for electric vehicle charging networks
segments.description: Supplies digitally enabled equipment, payment and operating software to convenience retail, car wash, fleet and electric vehicle charging operators worldwide.
segments.evidence: Mobility Technologies provides digitally enabled equipment and operating software solutions to drive automation, productivity and compliance across the mobility ecosystem.

segments.name: Repair Solutions
segments.description: Manufactures and distributes aftermarket vehicle repair tools, toolboxes and diagnostic equipment and software to professional mechanics through mobile franchisees.
segments.evidence: Repair Solutions comprises the Matco Tools business, a leading manufacturer and distributor of aftermarket vehicle repair tools, toolboxes, automotive diagnostic equipment and software through a robust network of mobile franchisees, who purchase vehicle repair tools, equipment and services from us and resell primarily to professional mechanics directly.

segments.name: Environmental & Fueling Solutions
products: environmental monitoring and leak detection systems
segments.description: Makes environmental monitoring, leak detection and fuel dispensing equipment and aftermarket parts and service for retail and commercial fueling operators.
segments.evidence: Environmental & Fueling Solutions is a leading manufacturer and provider of solutions to improve safety, environmental compliance and fueling efficiency globally.

revenueModel.text: Independent distributors and our direct sales personnel pay for equipment, software and services, while Repair Solutions franchisees pay fees and buy tools for resale.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales are generally made to independent distributors or through our direct sales personnel.

changes.text: The Coats business was divested in January 2024 and is reported in Other for prior periods.
changes.evidence: Our Coats business, which was divested during January 2024, is presented in Other for periods prior to the divestiture.
